fields.schemeName: National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: NACO initiated the Internship Programme for young students who wish to engage with the Government. The internship programme envisages an opportunity for young students to get familiar with and understand the various dimensions of policy-making & implementation of the National AIDS Control Programme.

fields.schemeName: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to ST families during the marriage of girls, providing ₹12,000 per couple as financial assistance to eligible tribal women across the state.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Purchase of Educational Instruments for Medical, Engineering and Technical Diploma Courses
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide annual financial assistance of ₹15,000, ₹10,000, and ₹5,000 for ST students in medical, engineering, and diploma courses, respectively.

fields.schemeName: Advocate Graduate Stipend Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, junior lawyers receive stipends up to ₹10,000 per month and their senior advocates receive an allowance of ₹5,000 per month.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Environment,forests and climate change
fields.schemeName: Internship Programme Of The Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (MoEFCC)
fields.briefDescription: Internship at Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB) provides an excellent opportunity for students/researchers to familiarize themselves with various issues related to wildlife & the functioning of WCCB. The intern shall have an orientation session and will be assigned specific areas of work.

fields.schemeName: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional deliveries among poor pregnant women. It offers cash assistance for institutional and home deliveries, along with antenatal and postnatal care support, primarily benefiting poor pregnant women across India.

fields.schemeName: Indo-French Postdoctoral Research Programme for Women in Science
fields.briefDescription: This programme will provide a platform for women candidates to engage & work with Indian/French scientific communities with an aim to accelerate their talented instincts towards carrying out advanced studies and research in the frontier areas of Science & Technology.

fields.schemeName: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Supply of Baby Pulpers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Supply of Baby Pulpers" aims to facilitate the improvement of the quality of coffee produced by growers by encouraging them to establish infrastructure for quality enhancement and obtain certification for their coffees, enabling them to earn better returns.

fields.schemeName: Women Scientist Scheme-C
fields.briefDescription: A scheme by MoST for female candidates with a break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. 1-year training is provided in Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), patent search, know-how, drafting, filing, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a secure savings option with assured returns for women. Through this scheme, 7.5% interest and flexible savings benefits are provided to women and minor girls.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Petroleum and Natural Gas
fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
fields.briefDescription: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG), introduced the ‘"Pradhan Mantri Ujjawala Yojana 2.0" in India. The Pradhan Mantri Ujjawala Yojana (PMUY) is a scheme launched by the Government of India in 2016 to provide free LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) connections to women from below-poverty-line.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
fields.schemeName: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
fields.briefDescription: The Ministry of Women and Child Development launched the Internship Programme aims to harness the talent of the trainees, giving them an opportunity to work towards bringing more efficiency in the implementation of the schemes.

fields.schemeName: VAANI (Vibrant Advocacy for Advancement and Nurturing of Indian Languages)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create a knowledge base by conducting conferences, seminars, and workshops in twenty-two Indian languages. The scheme provides a maximum funding of ₹2,00,000/- per programme to eligible institutions, along with an honorarium of up to ₹5,000/- per session for subject experts.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is to provide maternity benefits to women belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections of society. For first child the maternity benefit of ₹5,000 is provided in two instalments under PMMVY and second child, it is ₹6,000 is to be provided subject to second child is girl.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Sericulture In Irrigated Area
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides loans to farmers for sericulture activities in irrigated areas, with a loan amount ranging from ₹49,000/- to ₹79,000/- per acre, and interest rates from 11% to 12.75%.

fields.schemeName: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme allows young talent to be associated with the NCCS work for mutual benefit. It will enable NCCS to interact with young scholars and to get fresh ideas and study/ research support from the field of academics.

fields.schemeName: ICMR-Junior Research Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and research opportunities to eligible candidates through Junior Research Fellowship for pursuing Ph.D. programmes in medical and social science fields.

fields.schemeName: Welfare Services for Disabled Persons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide support, rehabilitation, and empowerment to persons with disabilities through financial assistance for healthcare, education, vocational training, and assistive devices.

fields.schemeName: DPIIT Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: DPIIT has introduced an internship scheme for students pursuing Under Graduate/Post Graduate degrees or Research Scholars enrolled in recognized universities/Institutions within India or abroad. The applicants can choose the  period of their choice ranging from one/two/three months.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Award Of Senior/Junior Fellowships To Outstanding Persons In The Fields Of Culture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Award of Senior/Junior Fellowships to Outstanding Persons in the Fields of Culture” was launched by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Iron Boxes at Free of Cost
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides complimentary iron boxes to support individuals from Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNCs) engaged in washing work, aiming to improve their livelihood.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Divyangjan Kaushal Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure dignified livelihood opportunities for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) by providing industry-relevant and customized training specific to each group. The scheme provides skill development in high-growth sectors such as Information Technology, Animation, Visual Effect, etc.

fields.schemeName: Short Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide short-term advanced training and financial support to medical and health research personnel to enhance their skills and promote research in priority health areas.

fields.schemeName: Sagar Samman Award- Recognition of Outstanding Maritime Training Institutes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize excellence in maritime education and training by providing rankings and recognition to top maritime institutes.

fields.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship for the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribe for Studies in India
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enable eligible Scheduled Tribe students to undertake quality education from the post-matriculation to the post-graduate level. It provides financial assistance covering compulsory course fees and monthly stipends for intended beneficiaries, including hostellers and day scholars.

fields.schemeName: Welfare Services for Children
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and development support to vulnerable children such as orphans, street children, child labourers, and children affected by HIV/AIDS. It focuses on shelter, education, health, and rehabilitation services.

fields.schemeName: Uttar Poorva Transformative Industrialization Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The UNNATI (Uttar Poorva Transformative Industrialization Scheme), 2024, is a Government of India initiative for Northeastern region of India offering various incentives to the industries in both sectors Manufacturing and Service.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education (HPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The Financial Assistance for Education Scheme has been introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) to provide annual educational assistance for up to two children of a beneficiary, from Class I to professional and research courses.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Dr. Ambedakar Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for the Economically Backward Class (EBC) Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Economically Backward Class (EBC) students studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships shall be available for studies in India only.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs
fields.briefDescription: The "Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs" scheme aims to involve the voluntary sector in improving the educational and socio-economic conditions of the target group i.e. OBCs to upgrade skills to enable them to start income-generating activities on their own.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: PM Vishwakarma
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "PM Vishwakarma " by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, is a new scheme that envisages providing end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople in scaling up their conventional products and services.

fields.schemeName: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
fields.briefDescription: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young specially-abled student the opportunity to study further.

fields.schemeName: Biotechnology Career Advancement And Re-orientation (BioCARe) Programme For Women Scientists
fields.briefDescription: Biotechnology Career Advancement and Re-orientation (BioCARe) Programme, a special scheme of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, the government of India aims to enhance the participation of women scientists in India towards research in Biotechnology.

fields.schemeName: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Program by the Indian Patent Office recognizes the abundance of creative and innovative energies that flow in India, and the need to tap into and channelize these energies. The program aims to work towards the fulfilment of the objectives of the National IPR Policy.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: SAHAKAR MITRA: NCDC’s Scheme on Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The programme aims at providing an opportunity to professional graduates to get experience in areas of functioning of NCDC and related aspects of cooperatives.

fields.schemeName: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage original and translated book writing in Hindi. Through this scheme, monetary awards, certificates, and mementos are provided to Indian authors.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Post-Doctoral Fellowships (PDF)
fields.briefDescription: This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications & recognitions. Support is provided for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of 1 year, to encourage specialized research in emerging area.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: National Agriculture Market
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 14th April 2016, e-NAM is a pan-India electronic trading platform that links existing mandis to create a unified online market for agricultural commodities, promoting “One Nation One Market” and enabling transparent, efficient, and nationwide agri-trade.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Water Resources,River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation
fields.schemeName: Research and Development Programme in Water Sector
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to solve water sector problems through effective research and development. It provides Grants-in-Aid to academicians, universities, laboratories, government departments, and Non-Governmental Organizations to fund basic, applied, and action research projects.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Integrated Dairy Development Project (IDDP)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen dairy livelihoods through Gir cow induction. Through this scheme, financial assistance and subsidies are provided to beneficiaries for cows, feed, infrastructure, and insurance.

fields.schemeName: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme For Award To Distinguished Artistes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "CMAT - Scheme for Award to Distinguished Artistes" is a scheme by the Dept. of Art & Culture, Govt. of Manipur, to encourage and felicitate the artistes (in the field of culture) belonging to different fields for their achievements such as winning National Awards namely Padma Award, etc.

fields.schemeName: Financial Support Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to financially weak students of the University of Delhi to help them overcome financial challenges and continue their education without hardship.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to propagate and develop literature in the field of law in Hindi and other regional languages. It provides financial grants to voluntary organisations for publishing legal books, commentaries, and journals.

fields.schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences.

fields.schemeName: NAMO Shree Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure proper nutritional support to pregnant women and lactating mothers and encourage institutional deliveries. It provides financial assistance of ₹12,000/- to eligible women beneficiaries covering expenses from conception to delivery.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Environment,forests and climate change
fields.schemeName: Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage the demand for environment-friendly products that cause lesser adverse impacts on the environment. It provides an Ecomark label for products meeting specified environmental criteria to eligible producers, manufacturers, importers, and exporters.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Cash Incentive to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to reward outstanding sportspersons for their achievements at the global level. It aims to simplify eligibility, improve the award process, motivate athletes to achieve higher, and inspire young people to take up sports.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
fields.schemeName: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to ensure, sustain, and strengthen child protection at the family and community levels, promote family-based non-institutional care, and provide financial support to children in need.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Government Affordable Rental Housing Development Support
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase affordable rental housing infrastructure. Through this scheme, land identification and government housing development support are provided.

fields.schemeName: PRL's Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS)
fields.briefDescription: The Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS) program is an initiative by the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) to honor the legacy of Prof. Vikram Sarabhai by supporting young doctorates to pursue groundbreaking research in fundamental science with societal impact.
